d: The pompous Latina, Kiki Melendez (Showtime Networks Hot Tamales Live!) Vicki Barbolak (aka Trailer Vick from America's Got Talent on NBC), and Crystal Powell (America's Got Talent on NBC) embark on a much needed vacay, creating a unique Comedy Special/Travel extravaganza through the gorgeous island of the Dominican Republic. Pack your bags for a laugh out loud adventure!

Fall under the spell of these five hilariously talented black women from all walks of life, and all parts of the U.S., in this side splitting stand-up special. Starring NY's Brooklyn Jones, LA's Alycia Cooper, Chicago's Just Nesh, Milwaukee's Kelly Kellz and hosted by Atlanta's Ashima Franklin. Filmed on location live from Punta Cana, Dominican Republic.

Tyrie is a successful attorney who appears to have it all. She has a devoted husband, beautiful daughter and amazing friends. When Tyrie decides to run for political office, her once perfect life begins to unravel. With her personal and professional life in disarray, she struggles to pick up the pieces. It seems like there is a force working to sabotage her... but what?
Held hostage in a diner, ten very different people, learn they have more in common than it appears.
